sources.title: Predict Taxi Fare with a BigQuery ML Forecasting Model - Coursera
sources.snippet: About this project This is a self-paced lab that takes place in the Google Cloud console. In this lab, you will explore millions of New York City yellow taxi cab trips available in a BigQuery Public Dataset, create an ML model inside of BigQuery to predict the fare, and evaluate the performance of your model to make predictions.
